## About
Hillsdale Auto Parts is on St. Louis Avenue in St. Louis. We stock parts for all makes and models: foreign and domestic autos, light trucks and vans.
We also carry new and aftermarket parts, including ring and pinions, RWD axles and manual transmission parts. We rebuild rear ends, manual transmissions and transfer cases, and we buy vehicles for salvage.
Customers rate us 4.5 from 53 Google reviews. One reviewer called the place "Clean organized and friendly." Call us with the part you need.

## Services
- Foreign and domestic autos, light trucks, and vans: A wide selection for all makes and models.
- New and Aftermarket parts: Including ring and pinions, RWD axles, manual transmission parts and more.
- Rear end and manual transmission rebuilds: We rebuild rear ends, manual transmissions and transfer cases.
- We buy vehicles for salvage: Got a vehicle you're done with? Call us about selling it for salvage.
- Free local delivery to businesses: Shops and other local businesses can get parts delivered free.

## FAQ
Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. All parts include a 30 day warranty.

Q: Do you deliver?
A: We offer free local delivery to businesses.

Q: Will you buy my old vehicle?
A: We buy vehicles for salvage. Give us a call.
